data.registration_json: help --topic register returns the public example; register --help shows command arguments
data.execution_output: run/recover/verify return compact data.record states, metrics and preserved artifact paths; --full or show returns full original detail
data.memory_query: Literal substring search, not token or semantic search; use limit/offset pages
data.laya: Optional prepare/resolve exchange for externally executed Laya; help --topic laya returns input and instructions
data.conflicts: --expect workspace revision to reject stale writes
data.unknown_resume: recover inspects receipts; unknown executions are never automatically restarted
data.roles: agent records proposals/registers/runs; owner freezes validators; fixed verifier produces verified metrics
data.security: Local capabilities and hashes are not OS isolation
